text:
At the bottom of the sea

there is a house of glass.


Onto an avenue

of madrepores

it opens.


A great golden fish,

at five o'clock,

comes to greet me.


It brings me

a red bouquet

of coral flowers.


I sleep in a bed

a little bluer

than the sea.


An octopus

winks at me

through the glass.

In the green forest

that surrounds me

—ding dong... ding dang—

there sway and sing

the mermaids

of sea-green mother-of-pearl.


And above my head

there burn, in the twilight,

the bristling tips of the sea.

translation.title: At the Bottom of the Sea...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the childlike underwater music and the crystalline house imagery.
